intro: The Alessa media unit makes small spaces work smarter. Raised legs, hidden compartments, and open shelving create an airy, organised feel—perfect for homes that love a tidy look.

features.title: Compact design that fits anywhere
features.text: Designed for small spaces, our media unit offers storage and display without taking up too much room—perfect for apartments or cosy setups.

features.title: Open shelves for décor and easy access
features.text: A mix of open shelving and a smooth display top gives you space for books, plants, or personal touches while keeping everyday items within reach.

features.title: Smooth top for display items
features.text: A sleek, spacious surface gives you room to showcase decorative pieces, family photos, or media essentials in a clutter-free way.

features.title: Dual-tone finish elevates style
features.text: A blend of warm wood and crisp white tones creates a clean, modern look that fits effortlessly into any home décor.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
